description: ADSR envelope generator taken from a circuit in a book of electronics for music, with a stereo VCA the envelope controls

params.text: Sets the rising rate of the envelope
Sets the rate at which the envelope falls to the sustain level
Sets the level the envelope holds at while the gate stays above 2V
Sets the rate at which the envelope returns to 0V
Attenuates and inverts the ATTACK input before it is added to the ATTACK knob
Attenuates and inverts the DECAY input before it is added to the DECAY knob
Attenuates and inverts the SUSTAIN input before it is added to the SUSTAIN knob
Attenuates and inverts the RELEASE input before it is added to the RELEASE knob
Sets the envelope's transition times over three settings: SOFT for longer transitions and a less snappy envelope, HARD for faster transitions and a snappier one, and a third setting, GENTLE

inputs.text: A signal above 2V starts the envelope, which releases when the signal falls below 2V
A control voltage added to the ATTACK setting, scaled by the ATTACK attenuverter
A control voltage added to the DECAY setting, scaled by the DECAY attenuverter
A control voltage added to the SUSTAIN setting, scaled by the SUSTAIN attenuverter
A control voltage added to the RELEASE setting, scaled by the RELEASE attenuverter
The left channel of the audio input to the VCA
The right channel of the audio input to the VCA

outputs.text: The left channel of the VCA, the input multiplied by the envelope
The right channel of the VCA, the input multiplied by the envelope
